'''Signal Intelligence''' was an organization of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. [[Jonas Balkar]] had a friend in Signal Intelligence.
